---
title: "Publications"
format: html
---

```{=html}
<style>

/* =========================================================
   MAIN PAGE TITLE
========================================================= */

#title-block-header h1,
.quarto-title h1,
.title h1 {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}


/* =========================================================
   PUBLICATIONS PAGE — FULL WIDTH
========================================================= */

.publications-page {
  width: 100vw;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
  margin-right: calc(50% - 50vw);
}

.publications-container {
  width: 92vw;
  max-width: 1600px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 2.5rem 0 4rem 0;
}


/* =========================================================
   SECTION HEADINGS
========================================================= */

.year-heading {
  background: #5a6f5e;
  color: white;

  font-size: 1.45rem;
  font-weight: 700;

  padding: 0.8rem 1.25rem;

  /* Space between major sections only */
  margin: 2rem 0 0 0;
}

.year-heading:first-child {
  margin-top: 0;
}


/* =========================================================
   PUBLICATION ENTRIES
========================================================= */

.pub-card {
  background: white;

  /* No gaps between publications within a section */
  margin: 0;

  padding: 1.2rem 1.5rem;

  /* Green accent */
  border-left: 5px solid #5a6f5e;

  /* Subtle divider between entries */
  border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd8cc;

  box-shadow: none;
  border-radius: 0;

  /* Publication text + metrics */
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 2rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.pub-content {
  min-width: 0;
}


/* =========================================================
   PUBLICATION TEXT
========================================================= */

.pub-card p {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.pub-card p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.pub-title {
  font-style: italic;
  margin-top: 0.55rem !important;
}


/* Journal + DOI / link */
.pub-details {
  margin-top: 0.35rem !important;
  margin-bottom: 0 !important;
}

.pub-journal {
  font-weight: 600;
}

.pub-separator {
  color: #888;
  margin: 0 0.35rem;
}

.pub-details a {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}


/* =========================================================
   METRIC BADGES
========================================================= */

.pub-badges {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 1rem;

  min-width: 125px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.pub-badges .altmetric-embed,
.pub-badges .__dimensions_badge_embed__ {
  margin: 0 !important;
}

.pub-badges p {
  margin: 0 !important;
}


/* =========================================================
   MOBILE
========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 750px) {

  .publications-container {
    width: calc(100% - 3rem);
    padding: 2rem 0 3rem 0;
  }

  .year-heading {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
    margin-top: 1.5rem;
  }

  .pub-card {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 0.8rem;
    padding: 1.1rem 1rem;
  }

  .pub-badges {
    justify-content: flex-start;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .pub-separator {
    margin: 0 0.2rem;
  }
}

</style>
```
